A '''battle''' was a battle of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith Empire]], fought in [[3996 BBY]]. At the [[Makem system]], the two sides fought with the Sith emerging as the victors.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle is only referenced once in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. It is marked on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] map showing the course of the Great Sith War rather than described in prose. In the ''Atlas'', the Makem system is denoted as the "Makem Te system"<ref name="TEA" /> after the planet of [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]], which it contains.<ref name="Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>
